source_evidence: You can typically choose among several investment options with an ABLE account, which may include mutual funds and money market funds.
question: What kinds of investment and savings options may be available in an ABLE account?
answer: ABLE accounts typically offer a choice of investment options, which may include mutual funds and money market funds. You may also be able to allocate funds to FDIC-insured savings or checking options; the available choices can vary by account.
